question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

T _ X T U _ _ U X T _ X
solution:
Given: T _ X T U _ _ U X T _ X

 
• T X X U → T **T **X - T U **X -** **X** U X -T **U** X
 
• U X T U → T **U** X - T U **X -****T **U X - T **U** X
 
• T U U X → T **T** X - T U **U -** **U** U X - T **X** X
 
• X T U X → T **X** X - T U **T -** **U** U X - T **X** X

Option 2) followed the cycle of TUX/TUX/TUX/TUX

Hence, the correct answer is **"U X T U".**
